title: Universal Plücker positivity and the Octopus inequality
summary: We prove a positivity theorem for the universal Plücker coordinates of Karp and Purbhoo when exactly one parameter is negative, with a sharp uniform threshold governed by the largest Plancherel up-transition probability. At the critical specialisation, positivity of the normalised $(2,2)$-coordinate is equivalent to the Octopus inequality, the main technical tool in the proof of Aldous's spectral gap conjecture.
